stack: Next.js 15.3 app router, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn (new-york/zinc), Geist via next/font, Lucide

bad_guidance.why: Pushes selection column + select-all, inline edit, column resize/reorder/visibility persistence and virtualised rows for a 30-row read-only invoice list; carries three forbidden concepts into the bundle and sets fingerprint grid_behavior=virtualized.
process.reuse_first was demanded (recommended) with this candidate at 0.207 but the bundle cap dropped it; on an existing-UI fix it is critical.

The only record that describes a load-more/pagination strategy for tables (search rank 3, 0.325) is absent; data.pagination_strategy is delivered only as a tag on comp-data-table whose text says 'virtualised rows'.

misses.what: problem_domain=layout for 'hard to scan … more than twenty rows'; the row-count cue was not read as a long-list/data-display signal, so no data concern and no pagination/exception concept became required.
data.exception_first never demanded (only for dashboard jobs); a11y.semantics never demanded in audit mode although a11y.accessible_names and a11y.contrast were.
table.column_priority has only mobile/tablet carrier records; filtered out on web although the table already hides columns at sm/md.
impl-reuse-before-new (process.reuse_first) dropped by the cap; comp-pagination (0.325) not selected while comp-data-table (0.264) carried the pagination tag without the content.
cta-toolbar-commands, imagery-data-graphics, metadata-rich proposed as new slots and grid_behavior=virtualized for a modify-one-read-only-table task; all had to be ignored.

components=table:tanstack asserted KNOWN from package.json with no import anywhere; react/shadcn adaptations then recommend TanStack Table. Typography evidence 'font family Var' instead of Geist via next/font.

knowledge_gaps: data.exception_first (no record in data/*.jsonl carries it; search -k 12 returns nothing about exceptions-first)
table.column_priority has no web carrier record

regressions.query: The invoices table on the billing page is hard to scan once there are more than twenty rows. (project: web, existing UI, shadcn)
regressions.expect: data.pagination_strategy and data.exception_first required; process.reuse_first required when artifact_state=existing and mode in polish/refactor/audit; a record that actually describes a table load-more/pagination strategy (comp-pagination) in the bundle; no core record pushing virtualisation, inline edit or bulk selection for < 100 read-only rows.

regressions.query: On phones the invoice table drops the wrong columns. (web project)
regressions.expect: table.column_priority delivered on platform web via a web carrier record.

regressions.query: inspect_project on a repo with @tanstack/react-table in package.json but no source import
regressions.expect: components does not claim table:tanstack as KNOWN; at most INFERRED with 'dependency only, no import'.

regressions.query: direction for a diagnose+modify task on an existing read-only table
regressions.expect: cta/imagery/metadata slots reported as not applicable or unchanged, not cta-toolbar-commands / imagery-data-graphics / metadata-rich; grid_behavior not virtualized below a few hundred rows.
a11y.semantics demanded alongside a11y.accessible_names and a11y.contrast.
